mechanism: Penicillins may enhance the nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity of aminoglycosides, and aminoglycosides may reduce the bactericidal efficacy of beta-lactams through antagonistic effects on cell wall synthesis.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and auditory function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative agents if possible or use lowest effective doses with extended dosing intervals for amikacin.
